name: kodflow-hud
description: Optional heads-up display beside the status line, as a mod (function hooks, Claude Code 2.1.293 or later): a Tasks pane with the main agent's open epics of kodflow-hooks' task list as a tree (subtasks, blockers, the critical path, the worker, model and effort on each task, the time since it last moved, a silent flag, the tasks waiting on the person), in the order they were opened, the active one marked, an epic closed with task_focus(close=true) gone, one idle for 24 h folded on one line, and the subagents' own tasks summed up under the task each was handed; driven by keys and clicks, a clicked row never moving from under the pointer; the only pane, so always the first tab and the one shown, its title counting the tasks left (the subagents are Claude Code's own list under the prompt); toasts for a task done, blocked or gone silent; a few words of each reply drawn in colour where the model marks them ({{r:…}} red, {{o:…}} orange, {{v:…}} green, {{p:…}} pink), the convention given in one system prompt section. A second view, « Chasse », and the views' bar with it, only while /hunt lists a run: each hunt's state, counter, pass, heavy queue, tip, Codex, pending decisions and the events since the view was last left, « figée » or « orpheline probable » when its beat is old, « reprendre » drafting /hunt --resume, never sent. No tool, no refusal; KODFLOW_COLORS=off turns off the colours and the section. Update it together with kodflow-hooks.

silentMinutes.title: Silent after (minutes)
silentMinutes.description: A task in progress with no activity from its worker for this long is flagged silent and toasted once.

autoOpen.title: Open the panes at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Tasks pane when a session starts. The engine seats an unasked pane only from 144 columns; /hud opens them at any width.

ci.title: CI of cited pull requests
ci.description: Every 5 minutes at most, ask gh pr checks about the GitHub pull request URLs that an open task cites, and show the result beside the task.

hunt.title: « Chasse » view of /hunt
hunt.description: While /hunt lists a run, show the « Chasse » view (read from ~/.local/state/hunt/active.json and each status.json) and toast its events. KODFLOW_HUD_HUNT=off turns it off too.
